lang.label: Language of this page
app.tagline: Press the button. Your own ComfyUI writes, casts, performs and films a radio play.
notice.asking: Asking your ComfyUI what it can make... (slower while it is rendering)
notice.unreachable: Cannot reach your ComfyUI: {error}  Start ComfyUI, then reload. (python -m radio_play_studio doctor says what is missing.)
field.bank.label: Story bank
field.bank.help: Where the story comes from. Pick shakespeare or public_domain to adapt a classic, my_story to use your own details below, or roll to be surprised.
field.source_ref.label: Source to adapt
field.source_ref.help: Optional. Name the classic to adapt (needs a named bank, not the roll).
field.language.label: Language of the play
field.language.help: The language the play is written and spoken in. The page's own language is the menu at the top right.
field.acts.label: Acts
field.cast_size.label: Cast size
field.style.label: Visual style
field.style.help: Restyles the still and video prompts, so it shows once a video lane draws from stills. On the audio-reactive lanes it changes the file name, not the picture.
field.stills.label: Still pictures
field.stills.help: Paints every still. Open models run here; paid ones run in the cloud and need a key. Character photos only work with FLUX 3 Klein.
field.my_characters.label: Who is in it
field.my_characters.help: Names, how they know each other, what they are like. Put (she) or (he) right after a name and that character is voiced and drawn that way; anyone unmarked is cast to fit the part. Leave it empty and the cast is invented for you.
field.my_photos.label: Character photos
field.my_photos.help: Optional. One line per character, Name = file, naming a picture in ComfyUI's input folder. The character's portrait is painted from it, in the episode's style, and every still follows the portrait. The cast cards fill this in when you add a photo.
field.my_plot.label: What happens
field.my_plot.help: Events, the trouble, a twist, the ending you want. Rough notes are fine: what you ask for outranks anything the writer would rather invent, and what you leave out is invented to fit.
field.my_setting.label: Where and when
field.my_setting.help: Place, era, weather, mood. This is the story's world, not its look: the Visual style choice sets the look.
field.my_author.label: Written by
field.my_author.help: Your name, a pen name, or whoever you want it credited to. The announcer says it and the closing credits print it; leave it empty and the episode credits one of our listeners.
mode.classic.title: A classic, or surprise me
mode.classic.text: Adapt Shakespeare or a public-domain story, or roll the dice.
mode.own.title: Tell my own story
mode.own.text: Write who is in it, what happens and where. The rest is filled in for you.
cast.label: Who is in it
cast.help: One card per character. Say how they look in fixed terms (age, build, face, hair, clothes) so they look the same in every shot, and add up to three photos of them if you like: their portrait is painted from it, in the episode's style, and every still follows that portrait. Photos need the flux3_klein still pictures. Leave the cards empty and the cast is invented for you.
card.name: Name
card.who_ph: Who they are: their part in the story, what they are like.
card.look_ph: How they look, in fixed terms: age, build, face, hair, the clothes they always wear.
photo.limit: Up to {n} photos of the same face
photo.too_old: This ComfyUI's Old-Time Radio pack is too old for photos; update it.
photo.sending: Sending the photo to your ComfyUI...
photo.unused: Your photos will not be used: {model} cannot paint a character from a picture. Pick {models} to use them.
photo.unused_here: Your photos will not be used: this workflow paints no character from a picture.
photo.unused_house: The example story's photos will not be used: {model} cannot paint a character from a picture. Pick {models} to use them.
photo.unused_house_here: The example story's photos will not be used: this workflow paints no character from a picture.
status.queued: Queued on your ComfyUI. A full episode takes a while; the bar moves in steps.
error.lost: Lost the connection to the app. Reload to pick the episode back up; if the app was restarted it is no longer tracked here, but it may still be rendering on your ComfyUI, and its episode lands in otr/obs.
error.untracked: That episode is not tracked any more (the app was restarted). If it was still rendering, it lands in your ComfyUI output folder under otr/obs.
go.direct_help: The play is written, cast and voiced as usual, then it stops after the stills: one picture for every line. Change any picture, try one again, keep the ones you like, then film. Filming is the slow part, so it only films what changed.
board.cast_help: A new portrait repaints every shot that character is in, except the kept ones, so try the shots first.
scene.title: Scene {n}
scene.note_ph: A few words every picture in this scene should share
shot.title: Shot {n}
shot.motion_fixed: This shot's motion is set by its lane.
why.still: This picture could not be painted. Paint it again or change its words, or keep the card to publish it as it is.
why.clip: This shot could not be filmed ({why}). Film it again, or keep it to publish it as it is.
hint.running: Working. You can keep editing; a change you make now is done on the next press.
hint.held: Studio is waiting to hear how the last run ended before it sends anything more.
hint.dirty: Only the changed shots are painted; everything else is kept. Paint them before filming.
hint.unfilmed: Filming films only the shots that are not filmed yet, or that you changed.
hint.failed: Failed shots: {n}. Paint or film them again, or keep them as they are, before publishing.
hint.ready: Every shot is filmed. Publishing mixes the voices and music under them.
hint.published: Published. Change anything and film again to publish a new cut.
pstatus.stale: This project was changed in another window. Reload to see it.
why.still_paint: This picture could not be painted. Paint it again, or change its words.
hint.blank: Pictures with no words: {n}. Describe them before painting.
why.blank: This picture has no words yet. Describe it before painting.
confirm.forget: Forget this run? If ComfyUI is still making it, Studio will not use what it makes, and this stage can be run again.
field.writer.label: Writer
field.writer.help: The model that writes the play. Local models run on this machine for free; OpenRouter, Google and Comfy are paid cloud models and need a key.
field.writer_openrouter.label: OpenRouter model
field.writer_openrouter.help: Used when the writer is OpenRouter. Needs OPENROUTER_API_KEY where ComfyUI runs.
field.writer_google.label: Google model
field.writer_google.help: Used when the writer is Google. Needs GEMINI_API_KEY (or GOOGLE_API_KEY) where ComfyUI runs.
field.writer_comfy.label: Comfy model
field.writer_comfy.help: Used when the writer is Comfy. Bills Comfy credits through the key on this page.
setup.legend: Your machine and how it's filmed
way.foley_sub: Voices, moving pictures and their own sound effects
way.stills_sub: Voices and still pictures with slow motion
keys.comfy_help: Paid Comfy models bill this key. This app holds it in memory until you close it; nothing is written to disk. ComfyUI keeps it with each job it runs, as it does for its own sign-in. Or start the Studio with OTR_COMFY_API_KEY set.
keys.comfy_set: A Comfy key is held for this session.
keys.file_help: ComfyUI reads this key itself: put it on the first line of {path}, or set {env} where ComfyUI runs.
keys.file_missing: No key file there yet (an environment variable works too).
way.time_min: About {n} min for {acts} act(s), measured on {gpu}
way.time_h: About {n} h for {acts} act(s), measured on {gpu}
way.unproven: Not yet proven: no published episode from it yet
